title: Platform Engineer – Support & Project Delivery
description:
Platform Engineer – Support & Project Delivery
Why This Role is Different
You'll be working across
multiple enterprise SaaS platforms
— Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others we take on as our business grows. You'll write real code that runs in real client environments from day one. You'll solve problems that matter. And you'll build a breadth of platform expertise that most developers take 5+ years to accumulate.
If you're the kind of person who gets bored doing the same thing twice — keep reading.
What Your Day Looks Like
Your work splits across two types of engagements, and the mix shifts week to week:
Solving Live Problems (Platform Support)
A client's automation suddenly stops firing. An integration starts throwing errors. A flow behaves weirdly after a platform release. You're the person who digs in, figures out what's happening, and ships the fix.
This isn't ticket-pushing. It's real engineering work on real production systems — reading other people's code, tracing logic, reproducing bugs, and often improving the solution while you're at it. It's one of the fastest ways to get genuinely good at a platform.
Building New Things (Project & Product Development)
When we kick off new implementation projects, you're building:
Custom Apex classes, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce flows
ServiceNow scripts, Flow Designer automations, and custom applications
API integrations
between SaaS platforms and client systems
Reusable components and internal tools
that make our team faster
You're not just executing specs — you'll have input on how things get designed and built.
Levelling Up
Pick up new SaaS platforms as we expand our service lines — we'll back you with time and resources to learn
Get certified on Salesforce, ServiceNow, or whatever platform you want to specialize in (we pay for it)
Work alongside senior consultants who've shipped on these platforms for years
What We're Looking For
You don't need Salesforce or ServiceNow experience. We'll teach you the platforms. What you need is:
Solid programming fundamentals
in any OO language — JavaScript, Java, Python, C#, whatever
A degree in CS / IS / related
OR 1–3 years building things in code
Debugging instincts
— you actually enjoy figuring out why something is broken
Self-starter energy
— you read documentation, you try things, you don't wait to be handed answers
Comfort switching contexts
— some days you're deep in a support investigation, some days you're building a new feature end-to-end
Clear written English
for technical documentation
Bonus points for any of:
Hands-on time with Salesforce, ServiceNow, HubSpot, Power Platform, or similar SaaS platforms
REST API / integration experience
Platform certifications (not required — we'll get you there)
Personal projects, hackathons, open source — anything that shows you build for fun
About Recur
At
Recur
, we build the technology that powers customer loyalty for some of Hong Kong's most recognizable brands.
Founded in 2019, we're a
certified Salesforce Consulting Partner, AppExchange ISV Partner, and ServiceNow implementation specialist
— a rare combination that means our engineers work across both professional services
and
product development. We don't just implement other people's platforms; we build our own.
RecurOmni
, our native omnichannel solution on the Salesforce AppExchange, connects WhatsApp, WeChat, Facebook Messenger, and LINE directly into enterprise CRM systems.
We're a fast-growing team based in Causeway Bay, obsessed with two things:
Experience
and
Innovation
. If you want to work somewhere your code actually ships — to real clients, into production, on a platform used by thousands — this is that place.
Link： https://www.recur.com.hk

title: AI Analytics Specialist
description:
About Wisers
Wisers is a leading expert in business intelligence and media big data analytics, leveraging advanced AI technologies to provide insights for over 3,000 corporate clients across all industries, including both public and private sectors. Our top-tier Chinese NLP, computer vision, and augmented analytical technologies transform vast amounts of data into actionable insights, helping our clients make strategic decisions.
About The Job
We are revolutionizing our social listening consultancy by building an AI-powered Marketing Consultant Agent (MCA). This role is a unique opportunity to shape the future of analytics, bridging the gap between our consulting expertise and AI technology. You will act as an "AI-native" power user, tasked with automating complex analysis, refining machine logic, and delivering high-impact, AI-assisted insights for clients in the luxury, retail, property, and public sectors.
Key Responsibilities
AI-Driven Knowledge Synthesis:
Translate complex marketing and social listening methodologies into structured prompts and reference knowledge for our AI Agent. You will maintain the "thinking process" guides that ensure our AI produces professional, high-quality analysis
Bridge the Technical Gap:
Act as the primary translator between our consulting team and our AI engineers. You will communicate business requirements clearly, ensuring the technical team builds features that solve real client problems
Rapid Validation & Quality Assurance:
Lead frequent "test-and-learn" cycles to validate AI outputs against real-world client deliverables. You will be responsible for identifying logic gaps and proactively finding ways to improve the Agent’s accuracy and neutrality
Proactive Workflow Innovation:
Do not just follow existing processes—experiment! Identify bottlenecks in our reporting workflows and iterate on new ways to use AI to make our analysis faster and more insightful
Strategic Insights:
Assist in interpreting AI-generated data to provide actionable marketing, branding, and public communication recommendations
Collaborative Product Development:
Provide continuous feedback to the development team, helping to refine "Agent Skills" and develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) based on your direct experience using the tool
About You
Education:
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Statistics, Marketing, Communication, Sociology, Psychology, or relevant disciplines.
Experience:
0–2 years of professional experience in an analytical, marketing, or research-driven role.
AI-Native Mindset:
A daily power user of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini). You don’t just use AI; you understand its logic, its limitations, and how to "steer" it to solve complex problems.
Proactive & Experimental:
You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in a fast-paced environment. When you see a problem, you reach for AI to solve it and iterate toward a better result without needing step-by-step instructions.
Business Acumen:
Strong sense of market research principles. Knowledge of the luxury, retail, property, or public sectors is a significant advantage.
Structured Communication:
Exceptional written English and Chinese. You can take a complex business request and break it down into the clear, logical steps required for an AI to follow.
Teamwork & Accountability:
Self-motivated and detail-oriented. You are capable of working independently while maintaining a strong collaborative spirit with both technical and consulting teams.
Language Skills:
Professional fluency in Chinese (Cantonese/Mandarin) and English, essential for interpreting regional social media sentiment.
Why Join Us?
At Wisers, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a steadily growing organization with immense potential. We offer:
Competitive salary with discretionary bonuses
Comprehensive medical insurance, including dental benefits
Friendly, dynamic, and collaborative work environment
Great exposure to big data analysis
Fully stocked pantry with a variety of games for relaxation
If you meet the qualifications and are ready to take on this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume along with your current and expected salary.
Apply now!

title: Senior Engineer/ Engineer/ Engineering Associate (PI), Multimodal AI Engineer
description:
Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) is founded in 2000 by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. As Hong Kong’s largest government-funded research and development centre, ASTRI is a key force and super‑connector driving innovation and technology advancement in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and the global innovation ecosystem. This role is strengthened through its merger with Nano and Advanced Materials Institute (NAMI).
Committed to bringing high‑impact research from lab to market, ASTRI advances interdisciplinary, market‑driven R&D that delivers practical innovations for industry and meaningful benefits for society.
Its technological strengths and capabilities enable AI‑powered, cross‑disciplinary ICT and advanced materials solutions across Smart City, Financial Technologies, Digital Health and Life Sciences, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Advanced Electronics, New Energy and Energy Storage, and Green and ESG Technologies.
Over the years, ASTRI has cultivated a strong pool of I&T talent and earned numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations and contributions to industry and the community. Following the merger with NAMI, ASTRI’s cumulative global patent portfolio has grown to over 1,500, with more than 2,200 technologies successfully transferred to industry.
With enhanced scale and capabilities, ASTRI is uniquely positioned to elevate Hong Kong’s innovation capacity, accelerate technology commercialisation, and drive societal and economic progress through world‑class applied research.
To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):
Job Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions focusing on automatic speech recognition (ASR), large language models (LLM), and multimodal AI systems.
Conduct algorithm research on ASR-LLM integration, model quantization, and optimization for resource-constrained environments.
Fine-tune and adapt foundation models (including Whisper, FunASR, Qwen-ASR, Qwen, Deepseek and other open-source models) for production applications.
Build and optimize end-to-end ML/AI pipelines from experimentation to deployment and monitoring.
Perform model evaluation and data benchmarking to enhance performance with high-quality datasets.
Explore emerging technologies including AI agents and tool-calling architectures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Contribute to technical strategy and establish best practices for AI development.
Perform ad-hoc duties as assigned.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related STEM discipline.
Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
Familiarity with model optimization techniques, MLOps practices, and deployment pipelines.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AliCloud, AWS, Azure, or GCP) is advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to work effectively in teams.
Good command of written and spoken English and Cantonese.
Lives ASTRI values.
You are suggested
NOT to include
sensitive personal information such as HKID or passport number, photo, etc.
Please quote the Job Ref No. and include the following information:
Name of University
Degree/PhD obtained/expecting and when
Have you participated in ITF Research Talent Hub before? Yes/No
If you answer Yes in item 3, please state the period
Have you been employed by ASTRI before? If yes, please state the period
For interested parties, please submit your application with detailed CV within two weeks of the post date. Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications as soon as possible. The review of applications will continue until post is filled.
The application will be open until the position is filled while ASTRI reserves the right not to fill the position. Only short-listed candidates will be notified.
ASTRI is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used exclusively for recruitment only. For details, please refer to ASTRI Privacy Policy Statement.

title: AI Data Project Specialist (One-Year Contract)
description:
Summary
As an AI Data Project Specialist (One-Year Contract), you will be responsible for data labelling, quality checking, summarizing and communicating data findings, client communication, and supporting the Data Manager in delivering data projects that are essential to our AI products and customer success. You will work in an energetic team and manage part-time or vendors for project delivery. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, responsible, and capable of working independently at the client’s site.
Contract Term
This is a one-year contract position from 15 June 2026 to 14 June 2027. The exact start and end dates may be adjusted within a reasonable range, subject to mutual agreement.
Responsibilities
As a Supervisor of 1-3 Data Labellers:
1. Work independently at the client’s site in a supervisory and task management capacity for data labelling and quality checking, ensuring that data meets the target accuracy rate and project timeline.
2. Train part-time teams on data labelling guidelines and the use of data labelling tools.
3. Communicate with clients on behalf of the data project team.
4. Summarize and share findings from work conducted at the client site with the Data Team and Research Team to help improve our AI products.
As a Data Labeller and Checker:
1. Conduct hands-on data labelling and quality checking to ensure that labelled data meets the target accuracy rate.
As a Data Project Assistant:
1. Assist the Data Manager in recruiting part-time or sourcing vendors for data labelling, data creation, and data sourcing projects.
2. Assist the Data Manager in delivering data labelling, data creation, and data sourcing projects with high quality, on time, and within budget.
Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above.
2. Native Cantonese speaker, with good command of written and spoken Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
3. At least 1 year of work experience, preferably in the technology industry and ideally with companies that provide data sourcing or data annotation services for speech recognition technologies.
4. Willingness to work at the client’s site as needed (estimated at 30% or more of time at the client’s site across a year).
5. Good communication skills.
6. Quick learner, open to new concepts and technologies, and willing to learn.
7. Self-motivated and willing to take on new responsibilities with a growth mindset.
8. Detail-oriented.
9. Able to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Competencies
1. Ownership: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes.
2. Reliability: Dependable and consistent in meeting commitments.
3. Commitment to Quality: Focused on delivering work with high quality and attention to detail.
4. Deliver Results: Consistently achieves goals and objectives.
5. Integrity: Upholds ethical principles and honesty in all actions.
What We Offer

Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (hereinafter referred to as “the Company”) is a private organization jointly owned by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and The Hong Kong Association of Banks. large-value interbank fund transfers denominated in HKD, USD, Euro and RMB;
